sequence.description: The log's head once the command committed: its last event, or the head it saw when it appended none.

changed.description: False for a command that was accepted and changed nothing, so appended no event.

sequence.description: The log's head when the command was rejected.

reason.description: Why the command was rejected, the code of its error: not_found when its target does not exist.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: The rejection as an error: its code (the reason), a message for people and structured data.

receipt.description: A command's receipt: accepted (with the head sequence after it and whether it changed anything) or rejected (with the reason and the error). A retry with the same commandId answers the same receipt.

result.description: The method's result, present when this request applied the command; absent on a retry and on a rejection.

id.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

label.description: An account's label: 1 to 200 characters on one line, with no space at either end; unique on its environment ignoring case, preset to the email the account signed in as.

nameByEmail.description: True only while this account still has an automatically supplied name, eligible to become its email. An explicit rename clears it.

kind.description: Whose config directory an account's is: adopted (the machine's own provider directory, registered in place and never moved, linked or deleted by the environment) or owned (made by the environment under its data directory for a fresh sign-in).

path.description: The directory's absolute path on the environment's machine.

directory.description: An account's config directory: whose it is, and where.

provider.description: A provider's id, as the environment's adapter registry keys it: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (claude).

email.description: The login's email, as the provider's status reports it.

organisation.description: The organisation the login belongs to, when the provider reports one.

anyOf.description: Who an account signed in as: the provider, the email and the organisation when present; one account per identity per environment.

identity.description: Who the account is signed in as, once a status read has said; null until then.

state.description: What an account's status read found: signed-in (it can run), signed-out, expired (the provider says its login has lapsed), unreadable (the provider read failed), or unavailable (a deadline elapsed; automatically retried). Only a signed-in account runs.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

checkedAt.description: When the status was last read; null until the first read.

detail.description: Why the status is what it is, when the read said: the provider's error or a temporary deadline and retry diagnostic.

status.description: An account's status: what its last read found, when, and why when the read said.

createdAt.description: When the account was adopted or added.

account.description: An account the environment holds: its id, provider, label, directory, identity, status and when it was adopted or added.
